title: Refactor `renderStrategyList()` to use modal triggers
description:
Plan Context: Replace the inline add form and full-page detail editor with a single shared modal dialog that supports moving repositories between stores via a dropdown integrated into the save flow.

Description: Remove the inline "Add Repository" form from the Strategy list page. Add an "Add Repository" button that opens the modal. Wire table row clicks to open the edit modal instead of navigating to the detail route. Update `wireRegisterButtons()` to open the add modal with pre-filled values.

Scope:
- `mcp-server/gui/public/views/strategy.js` — `renderStrategyList()`, `renderList()`, `wireRegisterButtons()`

Deliverables:
- Inline "Add Repository" card (`<div class="card mt-24">` containing `#add-repo-form`) removed.
- "Add Repository" button added in the page header area.
- Add button wired to call `renderRepoModal('add', null, stores, refreshCallback)`.
- Table row label cells changed from `<a href="#/strategy/...">` to `<button class="btn-link" data-edit-repo="[id]">` with click handlers that fetch the repo via `API.getRepo()` and open `renderRepoModal('edit', ...)`.
- `wireRegisterButtons()` updated to open the add modal with pre-filled values (`{ id: sanitiseSlug(folderName), label: folderName, folder_names: [folderName] }`).
- `storeDropdown` variable removed from `renderList()` (store dropdown is now inside the modal).

Estimated Complexity: Medium

Notes: The links to `#/strategy/:repoId` in `utils.js` (breadcrumb helper, line 130), `project-detail.js` (line 690), and `project-list.js` (line 167) will become dead links when the route is removed in WP-006. The downstream Dependency Sequencer should note this for WP-006's scope or create a follow-up.

Code Observations: `renderList()` (line 425) builds the inline form at line 473 (`<form id="add-repo-form">`). The `storeDropdown` variable is built at line 439 and injected at line 486. `wireRegisterButtons()` (line 163) currently scrolls to the inline form. The table row label cell at line 102 uses `<a href="#/strategy/...">` which will become a `<button>`. The plan's `#strategy-table-area` partial-render model means the form removal simplifies the rendering since the form-state preservation concern disappears.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The inline `#add-repo-form` is no longer present in the Strategy list page DOM.
An "Add Repository" button exists in the page header and opens the add modal when clicked.
Clicking a declared repository's label opens the edit modal pre-filled with the repo's current values (including `store_id` in multi-store mode).
Clicking a "Register" button on an undeclared row opens the add modal with pre-filled ID, label, and folder_names derived from the folder name.
The store dropdown is no longer rendered inline in `renderList()`.

summary: Removed the inline Add Repository form card (#add-repo-form) and its submit handler from renderList().
Added an 'Add Repository' button to the page-header div; wired it to renderRepoModal('add', ...).
Changed declared-repo label cells from <a href='#/strategy/...'> to <button class='btn-link' data-edit-repo='[id]'>.
Updated wireRegisterButtons() to open renderRepoModal for both undeclared-row Register clicks (add mode, prefilled) and declared-row label clicks (edit mode, fetches repo via API.getRepo()).
Removed storeDropdown variable from renderList() — store selection now lives inside the modal.
Added currentStores closure variable at renderStrategyList scope; set in renderList() so wireRegisterButtons() and refreshTable() callbacks always have current store data.
Updated top-of-file comment block and renderStrategyList JSDoc to reflect removal of form and Detail/Editor route dependency.
Updated empty-state message in buildTableHtml() to point users to the Add Repository button instead of the removed form.

comments.note: strategy.js wireRegisterButtons() now handles two distinct click patterns (Register + edit-repo). If a third interaction type is added in future, splitting into wireRegisterButtons() and wireEditButtons() would improve clarity.

strategy.js: The page-header Add Repository button sits inside the same <div> as the title and description with no layout wrapper — consistent with how other view files render action buttons (project-list.js uses the same pattern), so this is fine.

strategy.js refreshTable() passes the current checkbox state to wireRegisterButtons() indirectly via currentStores closure — works correctly but a future refactor could make the dependency explicit by accepting stores as a parameter.

summary: Verified strategy.js: #add-repo-form and storeDropdown variable fully removed — zero grep matches.

Browser-confirmed: Clicking 'AI Insights' label opened edit modal pre-filled with label, folder names (ai-insights, ai-insights-dev), all three vision fields, and correct store pre-selected (Ledger Internal).

Code-verified: wireRegisterButtons() calls renderRepoModal with prefill { id: sanitiseSlug(folderName), label: folderName, folder_names: [folderName] } — no undeclared repos in test environment, but code path confirmed correct.
Code-verified: currentStores closure correctly seeds wireRegisterButtons() and wireToggle() after each refreshTable() call.
All 5 acceptance criteria confirmed PASS. No regressions observed.

comments.note: strategy.js refreshTable(): rapid checkbox toggling could result in two overlapping API.listRepos() calls with a race condition — last responder wins. Pre-existing pattern, not introduced by this WP.

AC 4 (Register button prefill) could not be exercised live — no undeclared repos exist in the test environment. Verified via code review only; sanitiseSlug() and prefill object construction are correct.
